title: Checkout API 5xx spike after deploy
symptoms: HTTP 500 errors spiked on checkout-api right after release 4.12; NullPointerException in PaymentMapper; error rate 38%
root_cause: Release 4.12 introduced a null payment-method field not handled by PaymentMapper
resolution: Rolled back to 4.11, added null check and regression test
impact: Customers unable to pay for 22 minutes

title: Database connection pool exhausted
symptoms: Timeouts acquiring connection from pool; orders-service latency p99 above 12s; HikariPool timeout errors
root_cause: A slow unindexed query held connections open during a batch report job
resolution: Killed the batch job, added index on orders.created_at, capped report concurrency

title: Kubernetes node disk pressure evicting pods
symptoms: Pods evicted with DiskPressure; node ephemeral storage 95%; container logs growing without rotation
root_cause: Debug logging left enabled with no log rotation filled node disks
resolution: Cleaned logs, restored info log level, enabled logrotate and ephemeral-storage limits

title: Expired TLS certificate on API gateway
symptoms: Clients report SSL handshake failures; certificate expired; 100% of external traffic failing
root_cause: Certificate auto-renewal job failed silently after a DNS validation change
resolution: Manually renewed certificate, fixed DNS validation, added expiry alert at 14 days

title: Kafka consumer lag growing
symptoms: Consumer lag on events topic rising; processing delayed by hours; rebalancing loop in consumer group
root_cause: Consumers crashed in a rebalance loop because max.poll.interval.ms was too low for a slow downstream call
resolution: Increased max.poll.interval.ms, added batch size limit, scaled consumers

title: Memory leak in search service OOMKilled
symptoms: Pods OOMKilled every few hours; heap grows steadily; GC pauses increasing
root_cause: Unbounded in-memory cache without eviction in query suggester
resolution: Added LRU eviction with max size, restarted pods, added heap alert

title: Redis failover caused session loss
symptoms: Users logged out unexpectedly; Redis primary failover; connection reset errors
root_cause: Primary node ran out of memory and sentinel promoted a replica with stale data
resolution: Raised maxmemory, tuned eviction policy, added memory alert
impact: About 8 percent of users logged out

title: Elevated latency from third-party payment provider
symptoms: Payment authorization latency above 8s; upstream provider timeouts; retries amplifying load
root_cause: Upstream provider degradation combined with aggressive retries without backoff
resolution: Enabled circuit breaker and exponential backoff, switched to secondary provider

title: DNS resolution failures inside cluster
symptoms: Services fail with name resolution errors; CoreDNS pods crash looping; widespread 503s
root_cause: CoreDNS config change introduced invalid forward rule causing crash loop
resolution: Reverted CoreDNS ConfigMap, added config validation in CI

title: CI pipeline deploy blocked by flaky tests
symptoms: Deployments blocked, integration tests failing intermittently, timeouts on test database startup
root_cause: Shared test database container slow to start under runner load
resolution: Added readiness wait, increased runner resources, quarantined flaky tests
